review-01.author: Ananya S.
review-01.title: Finally one product for every surface
review-01.body: The kitchen cleaner cuts through months of cooking grease in one wipe. Smells fresh, not perfumed.

review-02.author: Rohit M.
review-02.title: Slides right off
review-02.body: Dishwash gel has been in the kitchen for the last one and a half months. Very less quantity is required, and it cleans exceptionally.

review-03.author: Priya K.
review-03.title: Kid and pet safe
review-03.body: I was worried about chemicals around my toddler. This cleans just as well and I don't have to hide the bottle.

review-04.author: Meera D.
review-04.title: Floor cleaner smells amazing
review-04.body: The herbal floor cleaner leaves the house smelling clean and the floors don't feel sticky afterwards.

review-05.author: Arjun P.
review-05.title: Hard water tap for years, gone
review-05.body: Years of hard-water limescale on our taps dissolved within minutes, with no scrubbing and no damage to the brass.

review-06.author: Sana F.
review-06.title: The laundry is brighter
review-06.body: No fragrances, no residue. Whites are actually getting whiter, which surprised me.

review-07.author: Karthik V.
review-07.title: Handwash doesn't dry my hands
review-07.body: Works for my dry, sensitive skin. Keeps the hands soft but gets the grime off.

review-08.author: Nandini R.
review-08.title: No more bleach smell
review-08.body: Toilet cleaner removes stains without the harsh chlorine smell that used to linger all day.

review-09.author: Deepak T.
review-09.title: Brass is a family heirloom that shines now
review-09.body: The brass cleaner brought back the shine on our Pooja items without any scrubbing or acids.

review-10.author: Sneha G.
review-10.title: The eraser is magical
review-10.body: Scuffs on the walls came off in seconds. Must have to have at home. I bought the full bundle after trying it.
